new_ops.name: two_stream_relative_attention
new_ops.reason: Needs an attention primitive with two streams sharing parameters: content stream h (queries attend to memory plus h at positions z_{<=t} under a permutation-derived mask) and query stream g (queries from g attend to memory plus h at z_{<t}, excluding self); Transformer-XL relative positional encodings, relative segment encoding bias a_ij=(q_i+b)^T s_ij added to logits, and cached previous-segment memory concatenated to K/V. Shapes: queries [T,d] per stream, keys/values [T_mem+T,d].

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Query stream initialised with a trainable vector w, run through the same layers with shared parameters; used for prediction during pretraining, dropped at finetuning
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Computationally, the first layer query stream is initialized with a trainable vector, i.e. $g_i^{(0)} = w$, while the content stream is set to the corresponding word embedding, i.e. $h_i^{(0)} = e(x_i)$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Segment recurrence: cached per-layer content representations of the previous segment concatenated into keys/values
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: Then, based on the permutation $\tilde{\rvz}$, we process the first segment, and then cache the obtained content representations $\tilde{\rvh}^{(m)}$ for each layer $m$.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Relative segment encodings: per-head learnable s_+ / s_- and bias b giving a_ij added to attention weights
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: When $i$ attends to $j$, the segment encoding $\mathbf{s}_{ij}$ is used to compute an attention weight $a_{ij} = (\mb{q}_i + \mb{b})^\top \mb{s}_{ij}$, where $\mb{q}_i$ is the query vector as in a standard attention operation and $\mb{b}$ is a learnable head-specific bias vector.

mechanisms_outside_ir.mechanism: Permutation of factorization order via attention masks (positions kept in original order)
mechanisms_outside_ir.quote: In other words, we keep the original sequence order, use the positional encodings corresponding to the original sequence, and rely on a proper attention mask in Transformers to achieve permutation of the factorization order.

output.notes: Described XLNet-Large (headline model, hyperparameters from the pretraining table). XLNet-Base is the ablation model; its sizes besides 12 layers are inherited from BERT-Base. Vocab size, LayerNorm eps, biases and GELU approximation are not stated. Family is given as other because the model is autoregressive over permuted factorization orders and is not a plain causal decoder. Tied embeddings are inferred from the same e(x) appearing in the input embedding and in the output softmax. Content-stream and query-stream attention are a single new primitive.
